name: streamRead
description: Pull the next bytes of a network.streamOpen response. Answers at once when bytes are queued or the response ended; otherwise holds up to waitMs (capped at 30 s). The bytes arrive on the binary transport as `chunk`; the envelope carries `done` and, when the response ended abnormally, `errorCode` / `errorMessage` (NETWORK_ERROR, TIMEOUT, RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE, EGRESS_BLOCKED, CANCELLED). After `done` the stream is gone. Additive action: an older host answers NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

inputs.name: waitMs
inputs.description: How long to hold the read for data. Default 0.
